opinions.text: Order of this Court entered November 5, 1973, dismissing appeals for want of substantial federal question is amended by deleting sentence which reads "Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of No. 73-275” and substituting in lieu thereof "Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these appeals."
